---
name: Discovery audit record
about: Record an evidence-backed decision for a discovered WorkBuddy resource
title: "Discovery hold: "
labels: [audit]
---

Candidate

- Repository: https://github.com/owner/repository
- Latest verified snapshot: YYYY-MM-DD
- GitHub reports N stars and SPDX license, or: no recognized license.

## Audit result

- Describe the published contents and the direct WorkBuddy relevance.
- Record source/provenance, licensing, and redistribution evidence.
- Record permissions, credentials, network destinations, data flow, and account/service-term boundaries.
- State any material evidence gap or reason the decision should not be inferred from popularity.

## Decision

Hold, curate, or exclude; state the concrete evidence needed for the next decision. This issue is an audit record, not an endorsement.
